Together they bracket the observability problem that any UAP sensor programme has to solve.

desc: The data that could resolve most of this exists, and it is classified for reasons that have nothing to do with the objects. Radar tracks, infrared imagery, electronic intelligence collection and measurement and signature intelligence are protected because releasing them reveals sensor sensitivity, coverage geometry and collection technique - the classic sources-and-methods problem - which means the government can be entirely sincere in withholding material that would also settle a public controversy. The National Security Agency's posture is the documented extreme: in Citizens Against UFO Secrecy v. NSA the courts sustained withholding of the substance of the agency's UFO-related holdings on the strength of the classified Yeates affidavit, and the released material is heavily redacted. The institutional convergence became explicit in August 2024, when a senior NSA researcher, Jon Kosloski, was appointed to lead AARO - placing a signals-intelligence technologist at the head of the office responsible for the government's UAP analysis. Congress has pushed on the same seam, requiring reporting on military intercepts over North America in the FY2026 NDAA cycle. Scoring high on this domain means an entity collected, held or adjudicated release of sensor data.
